question: what is the average order value of orders with promotions and without promotions on 2024's black friday?
expected_sql:
with blackfridayorders as (
    select 
        o.orderid,
        o.orderdate,
        sum(ol.quantity * ol.unitprice) as ordervalue,
        case when sd.specialdealid is not null then 'with promotion' else 'without promotion' end as promotionstatus
    from sales.orders o
    left join sales.orderlines ol on o.orderid = ol.orderid
    left join sales.specialdeals sd on ol.stockitemid = sd.stockitemid
    where o.orderdate = '2024-11-29'
    group by o.orderid, o.orderdate, promotionstatus
)
select 
    promotionstatus,
    avg(ordervalue) as averageordervalue
from blackfridayorders
group by promotionstatus;
returned_sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN op.has_promotion = 1 THEN 'With Promotion' ELSE 'Without Promotion' END AS promotion_status,
       AVG(op.order_value) AS average_order_value
FROM (
  SELECT o.orderid,
         SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unitprice) AS order_value,
         MAX(CASE WHEN sd.specialdealid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_promotion
  FROM wideworldimporters.sales.orders o
  JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.orderlines ol ON o.orderid = ol.orderid
  LEFT JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.specialdeals sd
    ON ol.stockitemid = sd.stockitemid
   AND sd.startdate <= o.orderdate
   AND sd.enddate >= o.orderdate
  WHERE o.orderdate = DATE '2024-11-29'
  GROUP BY o.orderid
) op
GROUP BY CASE WHEN op.has_promotion = 1 THEN 'With Promotion' ELSE 'Without Promotion' END;

question: calculate the customer count by state province name
expected_sql:
select
    sp.stateprovincename as state_province_name,
    count(c.customerid) as customer_count
from sales.customers c
join application.cities ct on c.deliverycityid = ct.cityid
join application.stateprovinces sp on ct.stateprovinceid = sp.stateprovinceid
group by sp.stateprovincename 
order by state_province_name desc;
returned_sql:
SELECT sp.stateprovincename, COUNT(DISTINCT cust.customerid) AS customer_count
FROM wideworldimporters.sales.customers AS cust
JOIN wideworldimporters.application.cities AS ci ON ci.cityid = cust.postalcityid
JOIN wideworldimporters.application.stateprovinces AS sp ON sp.stateprovinceid = ci.stateprovinceid
GROUP BY sp.stateprovincename
ORDER BY customer_count DESC

    c.customername as customername, 
    ct.customerid as customerid,
    avg(ct.transactionamount) as averagetransactionamount
from

question: calculate the average quantity sold for each stock item
expected_sql:
select 
    si.stockitemname, 
    avg(ol.quantity) as averagequantity
from 
    sales.orderlines ol
join 
    warehouse.stockitems si on ol.stockitemid = si.stockitemid
group by 
    si.stockitemname
order by 
    averagequantity desc;
returned_sql:

FROM wideworldimporters.sales.orderlines AS ol
JOIN wideworldimporters.warehouse.stockitems AS si
  ON ol.stockitemid = si.stockitemid
GROUP BY si.stockitemname
ORDER BY si.stockitemname;

question: what are the 5 top cities with the highest delay time in delivery?

with city_delays as (
    select
        c2.cityid as cityid,
        c2.cityname as cityname,
        avg(o.pickingcompletedwhen::date - o.orderdate::date) as avgdelaydays
    from
        sales.orders o
    join sales.customers c
        on o.customerid = c.customerid
    join application.cities c2
        on c.deliverycityid = c2.cityid
    where
        o.pickingcompletedwhen > o.orderdate
    group by
        c2.cityid,
        c2.cityname
)
select
    cityname,
    avgdelaydays
from
    city_delays
order by
    avgdelaydays desc 
limit 5;
returned_sql:

JOIN application.cities AS ci ON ci.cityid = cust.deliverycityid

  AND i.confirmeddeliverytime > o.expecteddeliverydate
GROUP BY ci.cityname
ORDER BY total_delay_days DESC
LIMIT 5

question: calculate the annual supplier purchase totals for 2014?
expected_sql:
select
  extract(year from po.orderdate)::int as year,
  s.suppliername,
  sum(pol.expectedunitpriceperouter * pol.receivedouters) as total_purchased
from purchasing.purchaseorders po
join purchasing.suppliers s on po.supplierid = s.supplierid
join purchasing.purchaseorderlines pol on po.purchaseorderid = pol.purchaseorderid
where extract(year from po.orderdate) = 2014
group by extract(year from po.orderdate), s.suppliername
order by s.suppliername;
returned_sql:
SELECT s.suppliername, SUM(pol.expectedunitpriceperouter * pol.receivedouters) AS total_purchased
FROM wideworldimporters.purchasing.purchaseorders AS po
JOIN wideworldimporters.purchasing.suppliers AS s ON po.supplierid = s.supplierid
JOIN wideworldimporters.purchasing.purchaseorderlines AS pol ON po.purchaseorderid = pol.purchaseorderid
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM po.orderdate) = 2014
GROUP BY s.suppliername
ORDER BY s.suppliername

question: what is the count of orders placed by each buying group?
expected_sql:
select 
    bg.buyinggroupname, 
    count(o.orderid) as order_count
from 
    sales.orders o
join 
    sales.customers c on o.customerid = c.customerid
join 
    sales.buyinggroups bg on c.buyinggroupid = bg.buyinggroupid
group by 
    bg.buyinggroupname
order by order_count desc;
returned_sql:
SELECT bg.buyinggroupname, COUNT(o.orderid) AS order_count
FROM wideworldimporters.sales.orders AS o
JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.customers AS c ON o.customerid = c.customerid
JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.buyinggroups AS bg ON c.buyinggroupid = bg.buyinggroupid
GROUP BY bg.buyinggroupname

    to_char(i.invoicedate, 'yyyy-mm') as month, 
    sum(i.totalchilleritems) + sum(i.totaldryitems) as totalsales
from 
    sales.invoices i
group by 
    to_char(i.invoicedate, 'yyyy-mm')
order by 
    month;
